svg.aria-label: The Reflex decision flow: state plus a typed question (choice, score, or yes/no) is embedded, routed to a domain, options scored corpus-is-the-model, calibrated by a sigmoid gate, then answered in microseconds with confidence or an honest abstain — loopback only, thresholds fitted offline from your own labeled data
